mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, asset_type AS assetType, asset_id AS assetId, version_no AS versionNo, source_version AS sourceVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, content_snapshot AS contentSnapshot, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt FROM test_asset_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND content_hash = #{contentHash} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, asset_type AS assetType, asset_id AS assetId, version_no AS versionNo, source_version AS sourceVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, content_snapshot AS contentSnapshot, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt FROM test_asset_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id, d.project_id AS projectId, d.original_name AS originalName, d.mime_type AS mimeType, d.file_size AS fileSize, d.sha256, d.duplicate, d.parse_status AS parseStatus, d.parser_type AS parserType, d.summary, d.error_message AS errorMessage, d.create_user AS createUser, d.create_time AS createTime, d.update_time AS updateTime, v.id AS assetVersionId, v.version_no AS assetVersionNo FROM ai_source_document d LEFT JOIN test_asset_version v ON v.id = ( SELECT iv.id FROM test_asset_version iv WHERE iv.project_id = d.project_id AND iv.asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND iv.asset_id = d.id ORDER BY iv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 )
ORDER BY d.update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.sql: FROM test_asset_version v LEFT JOIN ai_source_document d ON v.asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND d.id = v.asset_id AND d.project_id = v.project_id LEFT JOIN functional_case fc ON v.asset_type = 'CASE' AND fc.ref_id = v.asset_id AND fc.project_id = v.project_id AND fc.latest = 1 AND fc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task task ON v.asset_type = 'TASK' AND task.id = v.asset_id AND task.project_id = v.project_id
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.project_id AS projectId, v.asset_type AS assetType, v.asset_id AS assetId, AS assetName, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.source_version AS sourceVersion, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.status, v.created_by AS createdBy, v.created_at AS createdAt, v.published_by AS publishedBy, v.published_at AS publishedAt
ORDER BY v.published_at DESC, v.version_no DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT r.id, r.project_id AS projectId, r.relation_type AS relationType, r.source_asset_type AS sourceAssetType, r.source_asset_id AS sourceAssetId, COALESCE(sd.original_name, sfc.name, st.name, r.source_asset_id) AS sourceAssetName, r.source_version_id AS sourceVersionId, sv.version_no AS sourceVersionNo, r.target_asset_type AS targetAssetType, r.target_asset_id AS targetAssetId, COALESCE(td.original_name, tfc.name, tt.name, r.target_asset_id) AS targetAssetName, r.target_version_id AS targetVersionId, tv.version_no AS targetVersionNo, r.metadata, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM test_asset_relation r LEFT JOIN test_asset_version sv ON sv.id = r.source_version_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_version tv ON tv.id = r.target_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document sd ON r.source_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND sd.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case sfc ON r.source_asset_type = 'CASE' AND sfc.ref_id = r.source_asset_id AND sfc.latest = 1 AND sfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task st ON r.source_asset_type = 'TASK' AND st.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document td ON r.target_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND td.id = r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case tfc ON r.target_asset_type = 'CASE' AND tfc.ref_id = r.target_asset_id AND tfc.latest = 1 AND tfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task tt ON r.target_asset_type = 'TASK' AND tt.id = r.target_asset_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM test_asset_relation r LEFT JOIN ai_source_document sd ON r.source_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND sd.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case sfc ON r.source_asset_type = 'CASE' AND sfc.ref_id = r.source_asset_id AND sfc.latest = 1 AND sfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task st ON r.source_asset_type = 'TASK' AND st.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document td ON r.target_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND td.id = r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case tfc ON r.target_asset_type = 'CASE' AND tfc.ref_id = r.target_asset_id AND tfc.latest = 1 AND tfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task tt ON r.target_asset_type = 'TASK' AND tt.id = r.target_asset_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_asset_version (id, project_id, asset_type, asset_id, version_no, source_version, content_hash, content_snapshot, status, created_by, created_at, published_by, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{assetType}, #{assetId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceVersion}, #{contentHash}, #{contentSnapshot}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt})

INSERT IGNORE INTO test_asset_relation (id, project_id, relation_type, source_asset_type, source_asset_id, source_version_id, target_asset_type, target_asset_id, target_version_id, metadata, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{relationType}, #{sourceAssetType}, #{sourceAssetId}, COALESCE(#{sourceVersionId}, ''), #{targetAssetType}, #{targetAssetId}, COALESCE(#{targetVersionId}, ''), #{metadata}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
